summary: Woori Financial Group Inc. (WFG) filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board-approved small-scale share exchange to acquire all outstanding shares of TONGYANG Life Insurance not already held, making Tongyang a wholly-owned subsidiary. The exchange ratio is 1 WFG share per 0.2521056 Tongyang shares, based on market-price averages per Korean FSCMA rules, with no premium/discount applied; the base date is April 23, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is stated. The transaction is structured as a stock-for-stock exchange with new WFG shares issued. Watch for shareholder approvals and regulatory clearance in Korea; the fixed ratio implies minimal arbitrage risk.
